meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration. ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动组建多角色团队开展深度研究并产出引用报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要多角度、可追溯的深度研究
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate a multi-role research team and deliver a cited report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need thorough multi-angle deep research with citations.

howto.what: 启用后,Claude会先询问最终报告格式(默认PDF+DOCX),然后组建最多8人的协作研究团队,每个研究方向配一名成员,并安排质疑者进行辩论式交叉检验。它会穷尽搜索线索,用代码验证争议观点,最终产出带引用和图表、经过视觉与写作校对的综合报告。
howto.when: 当你说出含“ulw-research”或“ulw”的研究表述,提到“ultradebate”“hyperdebate”,或明确要求“研究/深度研究/超精确调查”时触发;普通提问与调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下量子计算的商用化现状
say.note: 会启动团队并询问报告格式

say.text: 做个 hyperdebate 研究:开源大模型的安全风险
say.note: 会组建含质疑者的团队进行辩论

say.text: 深度调查中国新能源汽车出海,要PDF
say.note: 会先确认格式,再产出对应报告

howto.what_en: Claude asks the final format (PDF+DOCX default), builds a max-size team (one member per axis + debaters), exhausts leads, proves contested claims by code, delivers a cited synthesis with charts, gated by visual QA and proofreading.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research demands: 'ulw-research'/'ulw' wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or asking for research/deep research/ultra-precise investigation, not for ordinary questions.

say_en.text: Research the commercialization of quantum computing with ulw-research
say_en.note: Starts the team and asks the report format

say_en.text: Run a hyperdebate research on security risks of open-source LLMs
say_en.note: Forms a team with skeptics to debate

say_en.text: Deep-research China's NEV exports, deliver a PDF
say_en.note: Confirms format, then produces the requested deliverable
